evidence_limits: Only genuine foreground motion from recording source 16 is used. Edits add opaque masks, native-scale crops, padding, explanatory text and chapter cuts. There are no inserted stills, reconstructed UI, synthesized motion, or speed-ups.

The complete source time is partitioned into retained and explicitly omitted intervals. Omitted intervals contain recorder setup, incidental publication/repository navigation, identifying telemetry/navigation, and conservative boundary margins. The highlight edit is selective; the seven archive videos retain the reviewed safe footage at original speed.
Raw 1087–1600 seconds (17:42:54–17:51:27 UTC) is an interrupted/idle interval. Automated event rows continue changing, but this must not be described as uninterrupted active testing.

Raw 2707.30–3127.35 seconds (18:09:54.30–18:16:54.35 UTC) is the Chromium Aw Snap and reload/loading window; 32.45 seconds of unrelated tab flashes are explicitly omitted. This is a browser interruption and does not by itself establish a Datadog backend outage or product defect.
An environment restart occurred around 18:30 UTC. The foreground recording continues showing the isolated session, so it is not visual proof of the restart process.

Foreground GitHub Apps configuration is retained from 18:35:17 UTC. The settled repository page remains foreground from 18:35:42 through recording end. Later draft/filter/order controls, the six-session inactive inventory, grouped-child stop checks, and final canonical-C1 restoration were background/direct-still observations; they are not presented as motion captured by this video.

The isolated B-only session visibly becomes INACTIVE and its child becomes DISABLED while historical captures remain. This does not prove the provider runtime or agent shut down. The all-ten-probes stop conclusion requires separate inspection evidence.

The C2 commit view shows seven added marker lines and commit prose describing a changed unit price and an unchanged C1 runtime. The unit-price diff is below the visible viewport. Actual runtime pinning and snapshot execution time were checked separately; commit prose and event-list display times alone do not establish those facts.

The upper editor can retain source from another control. Use the selected event stack pane to assess source availability. Generic missing-link messages do not independently distinguish repository-access scope from other source-link causes.

Browser chrome, account/profile/session/service identities, private repository URLs and runtime directory values are cropped or opaque-masked. Broad masks intentionally hide some adjacent ordinary UI. Preserved commit SHAs are technical evidence for the synthetic revision controls.

The source has 107254 stored frames and 50 adjacent timestamp gaps above the nominal 0.05 seconds, with a maximum step of 0.35 seconds. Constant-20-fps output holds existing recorded frames across gaps. Nominal timeline indices and stored-frame ordinals are different quantities.
UTC labels are derived from the recorder start. Provider timestamps, Datadog event-row display times and SDK execution timestamps are distinct evidence types.

Privacy verification combines sampled original-pixel review, dense transition checks, independent encoded-frame review, sampled OCR and reduced-resolution comparison of every stored frame in the settled final-page interval. It is not a guarantee of every source pixel. Every final MP4 fully decodes and is below 20000000 bytes.

This preparation task performs no external publication. Only the flat publish-archive and publish-highlights allowlisted deliverables are eligible; raw video, private review images/OCR, scripts and working logs are excluded.

raw_review.method: Inspected five-second contact sheets, full-resolution spot frames, and dense samples around every major observed mode transition. Full-rate scene-change scan informed cut positions; this was not a manual every-frame review.

additional_recovery_review.one_second_method: 421 extracted frames screened by header-region dark-pixel threshold; flagged frames inspected visually. Complemented by full-rate0.005 scene detection and exact cut-boundary images.

settled_final_page_structural_review.comparison: Every stored frame vs first frame, grayscale reduced to 256x158; abs diff >35; 2% changed pixels flags.
